clips.title: The story
paras: Sully Balloo's Letter carries a soldier's farewell from the waters beneath the Thandol Span. Addressed to his wife Sara in Ironforge, it bears the love that endured through his final days.

Beneath the Thandol Span, where the Wetlands road crosses toward the Arathi Highlands, a dwarf's skeletal remains lie pinned under rushing water. In his grasp rests a fragile, waterlogged envelope. The letter inside begins, “My dear Sara...” Its parchment has suffered beneath the water, but the ink still holds the care with which the dwarven defender wrote in his final days or hours. He never returned to Ironforge.
